validation_ack.reason: FY2022 EPS (US$0.06371, Prospectus FS Note 25, PDF p. 403) uses 1,430,392,365 weighted-average (split-restated) shares: the company had 8,333,333 restated shares until the 26-28 Dec 2022 restructuring issued 19,464,433 new Rp1,000,000 shares (= 129.76 bn restated) to Barito Pacific and Green Era for the inbreng of Star Energy shares (Prospectus PDF p. 26; FS Note 1/4). Year-end shares 129,771,220,000 x EPS therefore overstates profit ~90x. Real; nothing to fix.

research_notes: Source policy: every FY2023-FY2025 money figure is from that year's audited consolidated FS (bilingual, US$ thousand, on baritorenewables.co.id); FY2020-FY2022 from the audited FS reissued 13 Sep 2023 inside the IPO Final Prospectus (they are not re-audited elsewhere; FS2023 comparatives agree for FY2022 except CFO). FY2019: only the opening balances of the FY2020 statements exist (cash, equity); revenue, profit, assets and debt for 2019 are null. Interim: 9M2026 FS (authorised 30 Oct 2026). EBITDA, payout and dividends come from ARs, the prospectus, press releases, dividend notices and AGMS minutes as cited. The brief's IR domain 'barito-renewables.co.id' does not resolve (NXDOMAIN); the company site is https://www.baritorenewables.co.id (no bot protection, fetched directly).

Reporting currency USD: all money values are USD million (FS US$ thousand / 1,000). FS2024/FS2025 print '.' as the thousands separator (Indonesian style), FS2023, the prospectus FS and the 9M2026 FS print ','; values were read with that in mind. EPS is in full US$ per share.

Corporate history: incorporated 5 Feb 2018 as PT Barito Cahaya Nusantara. In Dec 2022 (Deed 83 of 26 Dec 2022) Barito Pacific and Green Era contributed their Star Energy (STAR/SEGHPL) shares in kind for 19,464,433 new shares; this is a restructuring under common control, so the FY2020-2022 FS present the combined group as if it had always existed. Also in Dec 2022 the group bought out non-controlling interests in Wayang Windu/Salak/Darajat for US$645 mn (Bangkok Bank loan), which cut equity attributable from 496.2 (2021) to 191.5 (2022) via other reserves and raised total_debt. Wind: Sidrap 1 (78.75 MW, PT UPC Sidrap Bayu Energi) and 51% of the Sukabumi and Lombok wind projects were acquired in 2024 (AR2024 PDF p. 12; FS2024 cash flow: acquisition of subsidiaries 101.0).

Share basis / pre-listing split: 1,250 shares of Rp1,000,000 until Dec 2022, 19,465,683 after the Dec-2022 issue. The shareholders approved a nominal split Rp1,000,000 -> Rp150 (1 old share -> 6,666.67 new; ratio 3 : 20,000), effective 8 Jun 2023 per FS Note 25, Deed No. 54 of 15 Jun 2023 approved by the Minister of Law 16 Jun 2023 (FS2025 PDF p. 16; 9M2026 FS PDF p. 108), giving 129,771,220,000 shares before the IPO. It is deliberately NOT in corporate_actions: it happened before the shares were listed (no ex-date, no traded price; the price series starts 9 Oct 2023) and the price fetcher would then expect a matching Yahoo split event. Instead every per-share value and share count is stored on the post-split (listing) basis the prospectus itself restates to: FY2020/2021 shares_out 8,333,333 and EPS 7.64460/10.33164; FY2022 shares_out 129,771,220,000 and EPS 0.06371 (weighted 1,430,392,365) - all with share_basis 2023-09-13. These pre-IPO per-share figures describe a different capital structure and are not comparable with 2023+ (reviewer: confirm the choice of not adding a split record).

IPO: 4,015,000,000 new shares at Rp780 (Rp3,131.7 bn), OJK effective 29 Sep 2023, listed 9 Oct 2023 (Final Prospectus PDF p. 1) -> 133,786,220,000 shares. Not a rights issue. No split, reverse split, bonus or rights issue since listing: AR2025 PDF p. 12 'In 2025, the Company did not carry out corporate actions, resulting in stock changes'; AR2024 corporate-action section (PDF p. 12) lists only acquisitions; issued shares are 133,786,220,000 in every FS from FY2023 to 30 Sep 2026. corporate_actions: none.

Treasury shares: buyback under OJK 13/2023 (significantly fluctuating market, no GMS approval) 24 Mar - 23 Jun 2025: 6,000,000 shares, Rp32 bn = US$1,930k (FS2025 Note 19e, PDF p. 116); a further 700,000 shares in 2026 (9M2026 FS Note 18e) -> 6,700,000 at 30 Sep 2026. Buyback disclosures on the IR site: Mar 2025, Feb 2026 (plan) and Oct 2026 ('Buyback Fluktuatif'). shares_out is net of treasury; EPS uses the weighted average (FY2025 133,781,832,877).

EBITDA: as reported (USD mn, rounded as printed; 2023 to one decimal). The only printed definition is in the prospectus (PDF p. 52 fn. 6): profit before tax + finance costs + D&A; the face-line sum reproduces the AR/press-release figures for 2023-2025 (501.9 / 515.3 / 518.0) and the 9M figures. For 2020-2022 the prospectus prints 426 / 441 / 472 while the face-line sum gives 426.2 / 441.3 / 472.9 and the printed margins (81.76% / 82.12% / 82.81%) imply 425.7 / 441.3 / 471.8, so the 2020 and 2022 prospectus EBITDA may exclude a small item; the printed values are stored.

operating_profit is null for every year: BREN's statement of profit or loss is by nature of expense and has no operating-profit subtotal (revenue - D&A - employee - consultants - PGE production allowance - finance costs - FX - interest income - others = profit before tax). Not computed.

capex = 'Additions of property, plant and equipment' + 'Additions of property on operating lease' (the FS carries the PLN-leased power plants as operating-lease property). Other investing outflows (deferred charges = drilling/workover, exploration & evaluation, capital spares, project development, acquisitions, bond investment) are excluded and listed in each capex note so a reviewer can re-base. FY2020 has no PP&E additions line value (nil) - capex = operating-lease property 23.272.

fx_usd_idr: the FS discloses the closing rate only as 'Rupiah 10,000 = US$0.xx' (two decimals, e.g. 0.60 for 2025 = 16,529-16,807 range), which is too coarse. The stored whole-rupiah rate is the ratio IDR amount / US$ equivalent of the FS's own translated monetary items in the 'net monetary assets and liabilities in foreign currencies' note (every row agrees to within 1-2 rupiah). Results equal the Bank Indonesia middle rates the FS says it uses: 2020 14,105; 2021 14,269; 2022 15,731; 2023 15,416; 2024 16,162; 2025 16,782; 30 Sep 2026 17,998, and each rounds to the printed US$-per-Rp10,000 rate. This is a derivation (flagged to the reviewer); BI's own pages could not be queried for past dates (the archived JISDOR page of 2 Jan 2025 shows 16,157 for 31 Dec 2024 - JISDOR, not the middle rate - so it was not used).

Dividends: dps is rupiah per share as paid (BREN declares in USD, the notice gives the rupiah amount); total is USD mn as approved. FY2023: interim Rp3.91 (Dec 2023) + final Rp2.03362 (Jun 2024) = USD 49.62 mn, 46.2%. FY2024: one interim payment Rp3.78334 (20 Dec 2024) = USD 31.75 mn, 26%, deemed final by the 2025 AGMS. FY2025: final Rp4.0933 (24 Jul 2026) = USD 30.5 mn, 23% - DPS and dates from news (see the record's note). FS2025 cash flow shows no dividend to owners in 2025. Pre-IPO dividends (SEGHPL to its shareholders US$9.235 mn in 2021 and US$36.0 mn in 2022) are not dividend records; FY2020-2022 payout_ratio is null.

FS authorisation dates used as share_basis: FS2023 15 Mar 2024 (PDF p. 38); FS2024 20 Mar 2025 (PDF p. 168 - the Note 2 sentence on PDF p. 35 says '20 March 2024', a typo in the FS); FS2025 18 Mar 2026 (PDF p. 167); 9M2026 FS 30 Oct 2026 (PDF p. 163); prospectus FS reissued 13 Sep 2023.

roe/roa are the AR/prospectus ratios as printed: profit for the year INCLUDING NCI over year-end TOTAL equity / total assets (not owners' ROE). production = AR electricity output (GWh); steam output is quoted in loc only. FY2024 electricity fell 4.8% on Darajat unit outages (AR2024 PDF p. 86).

Year-end prices (AR share tables): 2023 Rp7,475 (Dec 2023, first year after the Rp780 IPO), 2024 Rp9,275, 2025 Rp9,700. FY2020-2022: not listed (null). IDX imposed two cooling-down suspensions in 2024 (AR2024 PDF p. 12). The price file does not exist yet, so the price_year_end checks have not run.
